source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: Premature QRS-T occurs without a preceding sinus P wave; QRS-T morphology is essentially the same as normally conducted sinus beats.
Retrograde P-prime is inverted in II/III/aVF and upright in aVR.
Retrograde P-prime may precede QRS with P-prime-to-R < 120 ms, follow QRS with R-to-P-prime < 200 ms, or overlap QRS. A fixed example is provided for each position.
The pause is usually fully compensatory.

authored_choices.pPrimeVector: Reuses the PAC example's normalized P table and electrode vector [80,20,0,-100,80,60,20,-40,-60,-60], independently triggered by RetrogradeAtrialElectrical. This is not a renamed PAC schedule.

positionVariants.shared: P-prime duration of 80 ms, ventricular timing/morphology, coupling of 500 ms, pause of 1100 ms and group duration of 3200 ms are preserved. Overlap is additive; P-prime is not deleted and QRS tables are not modified.

implementation: Uses the original group*4+slot index: a 3200 ms group with three sinus beats followed by one premature junctional beat.
Only the final slot emits retrograde P-prime, without sinus P. Ventricular excitation is not inferred by adding sinus PR to this P-prime.
This example emits no additional sinus excitation at 2400 ms. The returning sinus P occurs at 3200 ms, with a 1600 ms R-to-returning-R interval.
Bounded half-open interval counts and finite lookback. Pressure accessors reuse actual ventricular mechanical times without replaying from the epoch.
Independent respiration is retained. Mechanical amplitudes and shapes keep existing parameters; ventricular mechanics can be explicitly disabled.
Both demos provide fixed examples with atomic switching/rejection; twelve-lead and monitor lead II share the source.

Post-QRS/overlapping variants shift only the final slot's RetrogradeAtrialElectrical and AtrialMechanical events. QRS, ventricular mechanics and pressure are identical. AtrialPeriodNs bounds CVP support by each variant's actual minimum atrial interval.
limitations: Fixed timing, amplitudes and intervals are authored choices, not traced textbook measurements or anatomical localization.
One fixed example is provided for each of the three P-prime positions. Other R-to-P-prime/P-prime-to-R intervals, aberrancy and compensatory pauses remain uncovered.
No sinus-node reset, concealed conduction, refractory behavior, reentry or first-escape triggering model.
No beatwise filling, stroke volume, pulse deficit or complete hemodynamic feedback.
Other PVC/VT/SVT, respiratory, perfusion and artifact gaps remain open; dynamic UI rulers remain deferred.
Windows visual behavior is not yet manually verified.
